value.displayName: reset 数值与空状态标题
value.purpose: 账户右侧 reset 次数及空状态标题。

label.purpose: 账户方案、提示和控件说明；局部 medium 或 semibold。

caption.purpose: reset 标签、重置时间和更新时间。

ring-number.purpose: 基础起始字号；按直径缩放，再自适应缩小以适配环内空间。使用 NSFont.monospacedDigitSystemFont；仅显示数字或未知符号，不带 %。

motion.name: popover-animation
motion.purpose: 展开与收起使用系统原生过渡，每次操作读取 Reduce Motion；切换账户重新定位已显示的面板。圆环无持续动画，同步期间仅显示系统 ProgressView。

native.extraction: Inspection of native Swift sources, current direction contract and independent v4 finish review of eight native offscreen renders; no web detector ran.

dynamicAppearance.staleArcsAndResetStrokes: NSColor.secondaryLabelColor; quota fills use the same stale treatment
dynamicAppearance.zeroRingTrack: Resolved usage color, alpha 0.55; no progress arc

ringGeometry.resetStrokeWidth: Exactly outerStrokeWidth(nested:diameter:), shared with the current outer ring
ringGeometry.numberFit: Start at typography.ring-number × scale; use CoreText glyph-path bounds and shrink by 0.05pt × scale until their diagonal fits 2 × holeRadius - 0.6pt × scale, with a 4pt × scale loop bound. Center using the glyph bounds so 100 is as large as possible within this clearance.
ringGeometry.centerContent: Rounded outer remaining number without %; unknown is —. Detail rows, tooltips and accessibility labels retain percentage semantics. Full appears only in a renderer test comparison, never as an application mode.

layout.panelAccountResets: includesResets: false; count displayed as adjacent text

components.name: Account ring
components.behavior: Outer long window + inner 5-hour window when both exist; thicker single ring otherwise. Each window uses its own rounded remaining-color band. Center shows outer remaining number without %. Each reset is an adjacent green stroke exactly matching the outer stroke width; stale resets are gray.

components.name: Account row
components.behavior: Select account to reveal actual window rows; reset count appears on the right.

components.name: Connection buttons
components.behavior: Disabled while connecting or awaiting login.

components.name: Account name
components.behavior: Up to 32 characters; native focus and editing feedback.

components.name: Panel auto-hide
components.behavior: First settings section. Enabled by default with a 3-second delay, configurable from 1 to 300 seconds or off; preferences persist. Returning to the panel or focusing a text field cancels the countdown.

components.name: Login at launch
components.behavior: No automatic registration; actual system status is refreshed. Pending approval keeps the request switch on and explicitly says automatic launch is not enabled. Changes disable the switch; errors are visible.

components.name: Quota detail
components.behavior: Named actual windows, remaining percentages, reset times and used percentages; no window selector. Remaining fills share the same rounded-value adaptive palette and stale treatment as the rings.

components.name: Quit button
components.behavior: Footer directly shows 退出 on overview and settings. One click terminates the application; there is no submenu.

energy.refreshDiscussion: Optional intervals and real-time refresh are discussion-only; no setting, default interval or behavior changed.

unverified: Actual desktop pointer exit/return and auto-hide timing
Text-editing focus and cancellation event integration
Perceived native open/close transitions and live Reduce Motion behavior
evidence.disposition: ship — limited to static native presentation and source inspection
evidence.tests: 27 tests passed in the parent implementation run; not repeated during documentation.
evidence.revisionBasis: User screenshots and additional requests led to the 18pt core, four independent remaining-color bands, reset/outer stroke equality and a maximized numeric 100 that clears the ring.
evidence.desktopAttempt: The earlier CUA attempt timed out; no new desktop CUA attempt ran in v4. Offscreen renders do not certify desktop interaction.
evidence.inspection: All eight v4 renders were opened and inspected by the parent and independent reviewer; static/source review found no material fixes.
evidence.powerMeasurement: No new energy measurement in v4; long-duration battery consumption remains unverified.

native.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS facsimiles or synthetic tonal ramps: native controls and dynamic system colors remain authoritative. Native components and offscreen evidence are recorded here; the web snippet array is intentionally empty.

autoHide.persistence: Settings.autoHideEnabled and Settings.autoHideDelaySeconds; missing fields decode to defaults.
autoHide.scheduling: Event driven, at most one one-shot Timer; only while visible, pointer outside, text editing inactive and auto-hide enabled.
autoHide.cancellation: Pointer return, editing focus, disabling and closing cancel pending work. Ending editing outside the panel starts the full delay. Generation checks reject stale callbacks.
autoHide.desktopEvidence: Actual hover/focus event integration and perceived delay remain unverified after the earlier CUA timeout; no new desktop attempt ran in v4.

usageBands.value: Clamp finite remaining percentage to 0–100, then round to match the displayed integer.
usageBands.windowBehavior: Outer and inner windows resolve independently; quota detail fills use the same palette. Unknown or stale values use NSColor.secondaryLabelColor.
usageBands.resetBehavior: Always adaptive usage green regardless of the remaining band; stale resets use NSColor.secondaryLabelColor.

narrative.overview:
每个已连接账户对应一个按余量分色的细圆环入口，环内以不带 `%` 的数字显示剩余百分比；额度周期、重置时间和账户设置在原生弹出面板中呈现。界面使用系统字体、SF Symbols 和 macOS 控件，保持紧凑、清楚、低干扰。

这是 v4 视觉修订的实现记录，主要依据 `Sources/CodexUsageRings/Views.swift`、`RingRenderer.swift`、`UsagePalette.swift`、`Application.swift`、`PanelAutoHide.swift`、`LoginAtLaunch.swift` 与 `Sources/UsageCore/UsageBand.swift`、`Models.swift`。尺寸均为 macOS 逻辑点，前置 token 不代表网页 CSS 配置；系统动态色、材质和控件外观继续由原生 API 决定。无演示模式，也不提供置顶或额度周期切换控件。
keyCharacteristics: 一账户一入口：两种额度使用外长内短的同心环，单窗口使用较厚单环。
中心数字显示外环剩余额度且不带 `%`；内外环各自按显示整数选择绿、蓝、黄、红，详情条保持一致。
右侧每条绿色竖线代表一次可用 banked reset，线宽与当前外环相同。
系统材质、系统字体和原生表单控件支持明暗外观。
面板支持可配置的鼠标移出自动收起；原生展开收起遵循减少动态效果，无持续动画。

rules.name: The Remaining Rule
rules.body: 弧长和额度条长度都表示剩余额度；中心数字取外环窗口，详情文字明确该窗口名称。

rules.name: The Band Rule
rules.body: 内外环独立按各自剩余百分比四舍五入后的显示整数取色，详情条复用同一分段规则；reset 保持绿色，过期状态统一转灰。

dos: **Do** 保持一账户一入口，按真实窗口使用外长内短双环或较厚单环。
**Do** 让中心数字与外环一致，省略环内 `%`，并逐条显示实际可用 reset。
**Do** 让内外环与各自详情条共享四段余量规则，reset 保持绿色且与外环同宽。
**Do** 用文字绿承载小字号绿色文字，并在明暗外观检查可读性。
**Do** 保留系统控件、键盘焦点和辅助标签，让 macOS 管理原生反馈。
**Do** 在原生展开收起时尊重 Reduce Motion，并在移回或编辑时取消自动收起计时。
**Do** 用文字区分未知、过期、等待批准和真实已同步状态。
donts: **Don't** 恢复演示、置顶或额度周期切换控件，也不要把测试中的 `Full` 作为应用显示模式。
**Don't** 为缺失窗口或未知 reset 数量生成推测的环或竖线。
**Don't** 为原生材质、系统动态色或系统圆角杜撰固定 CSS token。
**Don't** 加入持续动画或绕过既有低耗电刷新节奏。
**Don't** 将离屏 QA 渲染宣称为实际桌面截图、点击验证或电池续航证据。
